jobs.name: kit-natural
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production modular asset atlas for a 2D side-view pixel metroidvania. Use the provided approved reference sprite sheet as the strict craft anchor: restrained hand-crafted Underworld-like fine pixel clusters, very dark QUIET material interiors, tiny selected chipped edge highlights, precise silhouettes. This extends the same game, not a style redesign. NO cartoon thick cream outlines, no noisy every-pixel texture, no 3D bevel, no high frequency seams in the middle of terrain. Actual transparent RGBA background. Objects isolated with broad transparent gutters and no labels, frames or shadows outside objects. Four exact equally wide columns, equal rows. Col1 square terrain block; col2 principal architectural prop (largest); col3 small light fixture; col4 low attached foreground decoration. Terrain is a square front elevation patch with nine-slice-compatible edges, flat straight walkable top and square sides/bottom, sparse tiny edge chips and a particularly smooth low-contrast dark center 50%; no horizontal platform perspective. Light fixtures contain a tiny colored core but no painted halo, lighting applied later in engine. All props front-facing side-scroller elevation, grounded base, no floor plane. Uniform fine pixel art craft. Canvas 1536 by 1536. 4 rows by 4 columns, each cell contains exactly one complete isolated object, never overlapping adjacent cell. Rows TOP TO BOTTOM:
1. firefly_marsh: col1 saturated dark peat and wet clay with a narrow moss/reed rim; col2 leaning broken wooden floodgate with one tilted wheel and reed roots; col3 small bent reed post carrying one amber green firefly glass lantern; col4 low cluster of reed tufts and mossy half submerged roots.
2. windswept_canyon: col1 horizontal strata of dark mauve sandstone, thin sun ochre weathered top; col2 a windswept tall forked sandstone monolith with a broken narrow rope bridge remnant, asymmetrical, not an arch; col3 small rusted lantern on a crooked low canyon waypost; col4 thin dry grasses and curved sandstone rubble.
3. frostmirror_glacier: col1 dark blue slate bedrock capped with a narrow pale translucent ice lip; col2 two offset vertical fractured ice mirrors rising from slate, narrow angular asymmetric silhouette; col3 a little warm amber lamp trapped in a low angular ice pedestal; col4 low pointed ice shards and sparse frost grass.
4. moonshadow_cemetery: col1 worn bluegray limestone blocks under a thin dusty violet moss cap; col2 a leaning tall crescent memorial and two subordinate headstones with a broken iron rail, no full arch; col3 low grouped memorial candles inside an old iron bowl; col4 low crooked wrought iron fence fragment with dried pale flowers.
Preserve natural roughness and fine detail from reference at matching native pixel density. Every regional material must visibly differ, while edge detail density and shading remain the same game.

jobs.name: backgrounds-natural
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production sprite background sheet extending the APPROVED reference game rooms. Strict fine pixel art, hand placed small clusters and restrained edge accents, atmospheric quiet distant material. 2048 x 1152 canvas, exactly a 2 by 2 grid of four separate seamless-to-the-crop 16:9 room BACKGROUND PANELS, each 1024x576. No gutters, no borders, no labels or text, no characters, no floor platforms across bottom; these are far background plates only with lots of central airspace. Each panel is a different region. Match the fine pixel scale and muted cohesive palette language of the attached reference; no painterly blur, no 3D rendering, no chunky toy outlines. Atmospheric depth by value and hue, extremely restrained highlights. Composition TOP LEFT: firefly marsh: cool desaturated teal mist over a shallow dark wetland, distant reedbeds and drowned crooked trunks, one obscure old wooden sluice far away, small low yellow green firefly accents, a broad clear negative space through center. Deep twilight and low mist, not a bright lush jungle. TOP RIGHT: windswept canyon: immense stratified mauve sandstone walls, receding canyon turns and a distant broken narrow stone crossing, pale dusty gold late afternoon sky opening upper center, cool violet shadows, windblown sparse high cloud, no desert dunes. BOTTOM LEFT: frostmirror glacier: icy slate chasm and enormous pale fractured glacier faces receding into cold mist, desaturated powder blue and muted indigo, narrow soft sky opening upper left, a single distant tiny warm refuge light, no neon blue ice. BOTTOM RIGHT: moonshadow cemetery: broken cemetery silhouettes in cool lunar fog, low gravestones and distant delicate wrought iron cemetery fences, soft crescent moon behind a ragged bare bough high right, slate teal and restrained muted violet, center left quiet traversable visual space. Preserve side scrolling front elevation, mostly large shapes. Foreground and collision terrain will be separate.

jobs.name: quiet-regional-fills
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make a pixel texture source sheet for the quiet inner fill of 32 pixel terrain tiles. OPAQUE full canvas 1536x1152, exact 4 columns x 3 rows equal square cells without borders or gutters. Entire image is only flat material, no objects, NO lighting direction, NO large cracks, NO strong motifs, NO roots, NO metal pipes, NO edge bevels, no text. These are background material CORE textures to repeat without obvious spots. Match the inner darkness and restrained pixel grain of the reference game terrain. Every patch stays exceptionally quiet and dark, low variation, only tiny sparse crisp pixel grain, color variation at most about 5-10 out of255, no gradients. Twelve patches in row-major order:
1 nearly black brown peat with extremely subtle soil grain
2 deep desaturated purple brown sandstone with faint horizontal micrograin
3 deep cool navy slate with faint blue micrograin
4 deep muted blue violet limestone with faint pores
5 deep blue charcoal fine dressed masonry, faint barely visible regular brick joints
6 deep charcoal plum mineral stone with very faint horizontal lamination
7 deep desaturated green gray porous limestone with tiny low contrast pores
8 deep teal stone with very faint regular submerged brick joints
9 deep indigo gray cleft stone with sparse low contrast grain
10 very deep indigo glassy basalt, smooth and quiet
11 deep blue charcoal precision stone, nearly smooth with faint block seams
12 deep navy plain stone, almost smooth
Do not brighten to show the texture. Almost flat darkness is intended. Native fine pixel clusters, no blur.
